# PONSAJI

> A measuring instrument for Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). PONSAJI prices two
> classes of stablecoin position against each other — ERC-4626 vaults, where
> capital compounds, and fee-distribution tokens, where capital buys a share of
> somebody else's trading volume — and refuses to prepare anything that breaks
> a mandate you set.

PONSAJI is non-custodial. It never holds funds, never signs, and has no background
process. Your wallet is the only signer.

## What makes it different

Both fee-distribution protocols on this chain advertise what they pay. Neither
shows what a position costs to enter and exit, how fast the payout is decaying,
or how long capital must sit before the income has repaid the round trip. PONSAJI
computes that, states it under three volume regimes, and blocks the position
when it fails your mandate.

## The equations

Net carry, for a vault position:

    net = lending_yield + funding_income + incentive_value
        − borrow_cost − hedge_cost − protocol_fees
        − estimated_slippage − annualized_gas_cost

Round trip, for a distribution position:

    round_trip = entry_fee + exit_fee + price_impact(both legs) + gas(2 actions)

Income. For a pro-rata distribution the cycle total cancels out of the income
equation, so one recipient's payout divided by their balance is the whole
answer — which is why PONSAJI samples five real payouts instead of summing a
cycle of several thousand:

    payout_per_token = payout_to_recipient / recipient_balance
    income_per_day   = payout_per_token × tokens_held
                     × payout_asset_price × leg_count × cycles_per_day

Break-even, under a weekly decay factor r:

    k     = ln(r) / 7
    days  = ln(1 + cost·k / income_per_day) / k

When the decaying series converges below the cost, the position never repays and
PONSAJI reports NEVER rather than a large number that looks like a long wait.

## Data sources

- Fees: read from the contract that charges them (`FEE_BPS`, `currentFeeBps`).
- Cadence: read from the distributor (`interval`, `nextDistribution`).
- Payouts: Transfer logs of a live cycle, sampled and checked for pro-rata.
- Prices: Uniswap v4 `extsload` on the pool the asset actually trades in,
  and Chainlink for ETH/USD.
- Vault state: `asset`, `totalAssets`, `balanceOf`, `convertToAssets` onchain.
- Forward vault APY: Morpho's public GraphQL API. Unavailable → the row is
  labelled DEMO rather than shown with an invented yield.

## Rules PONSAJI holds itself to

- A number is measured or it is null. No default fee, no assumed cadence, no
  stand-in price.
- "Unknown" never renders as a confident value. A failed read and a genuine
  zero are always distinguished.
- No annualised headline is published for a decaying series.
- Claims are checked, not repeated: the pro-rata claim is verified against
  sampled recipients.

## Known limits

- PONSAJI has no background process. Nothing is monitored while the tab is closed.
- One payout leg is measured and scaled by the leg count each venue states it
  splits its basket across. That scaling is a documented claim, not a
  measurement, and is labelled as such wherever it appears.
- The public RPC intermittently returns a malformed CORS header, which the
  browser rejects. Affected reads degrade and say so.
- Balances are sampled at read time, not as of the cycle, so pro-rata agreement
  is a tight cluster rather than an exact match.

## Full documentation

- /llms-full.txt — every mechanic, source, and limit in one file

# Full reference

## Venues PONSAJI prices

### Vaults (kind: vault)

Morpho Vault V2, ERC-4626, USDG on Robinhood Chain.

| Recipe | Vault | Address |
|---|---|---|
| Steady Press | Steakhouse USDG | 0xBeEff033F34C046626B8D0A041844C5d1A5409dd |
| Carry Alloy | Ethena x Steakhouse USDG | 0xbEeFF0fb1Dc19344A87b8479dAb60A2e16160737 |
| Neutral Beam | Purinta USDG | 0x37788ff0c1d4e45A7FE06BC7e71e0cc00121d0A8 |

Note on `maxWithdraw`: these Vault V2 deployments return 0 for every holder PONSAJI
has read. That is the contract declining to expose an instant exit, not a
statement about the depositor's money. PONSAJI reports it as such and takes exit
depth from a separate source.

### Fee-distribution tokens (kind: distribution)

**The Index — $INDEX**
- Token: 0x56910D4409F3a0C78C64DD8D0545FF0705389870
- Fee hook: 0x2cD91bD228ff4c537031d6b8204782090c84c0cC (`FEE_BPS` = 300)
- Distributor: 0x39ADB8acD07427D338b5f1AfAb436A04AbFdB7c4 (`interval` = 3600)
- Pool: native ETH quote, 1% tier, tick spacing 200, hook attached
- Pays plain token holders, pro-rata, hourly, in 18 tokenized stocks.

**Quotrons — $QUOTRON**
- Token: 0x5a86828Efd322bfb16d93cFeD16EE9BC14940D7F
- Quoter: 0xb8960fdC8A0Be155d196C2795b75747763562df2
- Does NOT pay plain token holders. Rewards accrue to "hardwired" terminals —
  NFTs created by irreversibly burning the token. Holding $QUOTRON alone earns
  nothing. PONSAJI states this rather than computing a break-even that would imply
  otherwise.

## The mandate

Typed constraints compiled into the policy engine.

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| capital_usd | Most PONSAJI may commit across all open positions, not per action |
| base_assets | Settlement assets authorised, as a set |
| max_drawdown_bps | Simulated drawdown ceiling |
| max_slippage_bps | Order slippage ceiling |
| min_exit_liquidity_usd | Exit depth floor |
| max_round_trip_bps | Entry fee + exit fee ceiling |
| max_breakeven_days | Longest a position may take to repay its own cost |
| allow_leverage | Borrowed exposure permitted |
| approval_mode | manual only; session keys are not deployed |
| protocol_allowlist | Venues that may be interacted with |

## Policy checks

Each returns pass / review / block. The worst verdict governs.

| id | Blocks when |
|---|---|
| protocol_allowlist | A venue is not on the allowlist |
| base_asset | The recipe settles in an unauthorised asset |
| exit_liquidity | Exit depth is below the mandate floor |
| slippage | Projected slippage exceeds the ceiling |
| drawdown | Simulated drawdown exceeds the ceiling (review) |
| leverage | The recipe needs leverage the mandate disallows |
| oracle_freshness | A feed is past its publisher heartbeat. A venue with no oracle returns review, never pass — absence of a guarantee is not a guarantee |
| spend_cap | This allocation plus deployed capital exceeds the cap |
| round_trip_cost | Entry + exit fees exceed the ceiling |
| breakeven_horizon | The position never repays, or takes longer than allowed. Unmeasured returns review, never pass |
| simulation | The transaction simulation flagged something (review) |

## Decay regimes

Break-even is never quoted as one number.

| Regime | Weekly retention | Why |
|---|---|---|
| FLAT | 1.0 | Optimistic bound. Ruled out by observed cycles |
| −50% / WEEK | 0.5 | Moderate reading of observed decay |
| −90% / WEEK | 0.1 | Near the pace actually observed |

Observed basis: The Index's own published distribution table showed NVDA per
cycle falling 3.26 → 0.90 → 0.85 → 0.46 → 0.22 → 0.09 across six consecutive
hourly cycles on 26–27 August 2026 — a 97% fall in five hours. Quotrons states
in its own risk section that early per-terminal rates are not representative.

## Errors

| Condition | What it means | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| Row labelled DEMO | A live read failed for that venue | Rescan; check the RPC |
| "could not be read from this endpoint" | The public RPC returned a malformed CORS header | Retry; it is intermittent |
| Break-even "not measured" | No live payout could be sampled | Reload the recipe |
| Break-even NEVER | Under that regime, income never repays the round trip | Not an error |
| maxWithdraw NOT REPORTED | The call reverted | Distinguish from a genuine 0 |
| "Holding this token pays nothing" | The venue pays NFTs, not holders | Read the venue's own docs |
| Policy BLOCKED | A hard bound was breached | Widen the mandate, or do not take it |

## Disclaimer

Estimates are informational and do not guarantee returns. Onchain strategies
involve loss, liquidity, oracle and smart-contract risk. Tokenized stocks are
issued by third parties on upgradeable contracts, and that risk passes through
to anything denominated in them. Nothing here is financial advice.
